2024 · Lyonesse

Перетащите подкласс на персонажа с соответствующим базовым классом. Для форм и спутников используйте макрос «Управление подклассом». Ограничения указаны в каждой способности.

Ranger
Selkie Warden
Selkie Wardens are Rangers who have bound themselves to a selkie through possession of its seal skin. In claiming it, they do not merely command the selkie, but draw upon her nature, channeling the magic of the tides and the gift of transformation. This power is not freely given but shared through a bond neither of them can escape.
Such a bond is never whole. The Selkie Warden feels the selkie’s longing as their own, while the selkie senses the Selkie Warden’s presence like a wound that will not close. Affection and resentment coil together, tightening with time. Most Selkie Wardens come to understand that closeness only deepens the torment, and so they keep their distance, refusing to indulge the bond.
Selkie Wardens walk the line between love and control, between land and sea. The ocean remembers such bargains, and it always demands its due.
Level 3: Seal-Skin Reliquary
You possess a supernatural bond to a selkie’s skin, carried on your person. You gain a Swim Speed equal to your
Speed and can breathe underwater.
Level 3: Slip the Skin
As a Bonus Action, you can Slip the Skin to partially assume a selkie form for 1 minute:
• You have Advantage on Dexterity saving throws.
• Opportunity attacks against you are made with Disadvantage.
• You can move through Enemy spaces without treating them as Difficult Terrain.
You can use Slip the Skin a number of times equal to your
Wisdom modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.
Level 3: Drowning Mark
Your Hunter’s Mark manifests as an inexorable pull toward the deep. While a creature is marked by your
Hunter’s Mark:
• Its Speed is reduced by 10 feet, and it cannot benefit from effects that increase its Speed.
• If the marked creature willingly moves 10+ feet, it takes
Cold damage equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of 1) once per turn.
Level 3: Selkie Warden Spells
When you reach a Ranger level specified in the Selkie
Warden Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

Level 7: Molt
You can use Slip the Skin as part of the same Bonus Action as casting or moving Hunter’s Mark.
Level 11: Tidal Bond
Your bond tightens, improving your Slip the Skin. When your Slip the Skin is active, you gain the following additional benefits:
• You can move across any liquid surface as if it were solid ground and ignore any hazardous effects of such terrain while upon its surface. In addition, you ignore
Difficult Terrain caused by viscous liquid or currents.
• Creatures with the Prone condition can’t make Opportunity Attacks against you.
• When you move through a creature’s space that is one size larger than you or smaller, you can take 10 feet of your movement to force it to make a Strength saving throw. On a failure, it has the Prone condition. A creature makes this save only once per turn, and you can’t use this feature if you have 10 feet of movement or less remaining.
A selkie’s song has drowned more warriors than any storm.
—Cranhath Antonsson, Grimfolk Jarl
Level 15: Selkie’s Release
When you cast Hunter’s Mark, you can partially assume the form of the bound selkie. This form lasts until Hunter’s Mark ends.
Once you use this feature, you can’t use it again until you finish a Long Rest unless you expend a level 4+ spell slot (no action required).
While in this form, you gain the following benefits:
Call of the Sea. You can take a Bonus Action to call forth a geyser of water along the ground in a 50-foot long,
5-foot Wide, 5-foot tall Line. Ranged attacks passing through the wall have Disadvantage and creatures have Resistance to Fire damage from effects that pass through the wall. The wall is Difficult Terrain, but creatures can swim through it. The geyser remains until the spell ends or another geyser is called.
Drowning Grasp. When you mark a creature with your Hunter’s Mark, it makes a Strength saving throw.
On a failure it has the Restrained condition. While restrained in this way, it cannot breathe unless it can breathe underwater. The marked creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the condition on a success.
Fluid Body. Your Slip of the Skin improves, transforming you into a semi-transparent liquid. While your Slip of the Skin is active, you have Immunity to the Grappled,
Prone, and Restrained conditions. In addition, when you move through a creature’s space, it takes Cold damage equal to your Ranger level once per turn and you can move through any space as small as an inch. If you end your movement inside a space occupied by a creature or inside an object, you take 1d10 Force damage and are shunted to the nearest unoccupied space.
